title: Optimized Multilevel Sampling Methods under Resource Constraints
summary: We present recent developments in multilevel sampling methods under resource constraints. Over the past 15 years, multilevel methods have become widely used for uncertainty quantification. However, scaling them to high-dimensional problems and high-performance computing (HPC) environments remains challenging. In this work, we discuss two algorithms designed to address these issues: the budgeted Multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) method and the Multilevel Stochastic Gradient Descent (MLSGD) method.
